content.text: You need to sell your digital products online, but conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-6|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted in your region. This is a familiar challenge for creators in Zimbabwe, where payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-4|Tron USDT]]-tanzanian-online-sellers|options]] are limited and traditional financial infrastructure is inaccessible. The solution is not a workaround, but a robust, sovereign commerce infrastructure built on the principles of ownership and control.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This architecture is designed for resilience and autonomy. Instead of relying on centralized platforms that can arbitrarily restrict access, you deploy your own stack on decentralized infrastructure. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic without the need for costly servers. Supabase and Google Sheets store orders, while Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, with no middlemen. This combination ensures your store operates independently, without the risk of being shut down or restricted by a third party.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts. Sign up for GitHub and Cloudflare, and familiarize yourself with their respective interfaces. Create a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payments. You'll also need a crypto wallet to receive funds. For file storage and delivery, set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account. Gather your digital products, ensuring they are ready for distribution. This includes ebooks, courses, templates, or any other digital goods you plan to sell. Finally, choose your preferred stack: Stack 01 for a simpler setup or Stack 02 for more advanced features and customization.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The first step is configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. Set up NOWPayments to accept crypto payments in your preferred cryptocurrencies. Choose low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for cost-effective transactions. Integrate your crypto wallet to receive funds directly. For file delivery, decide between Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which offer free storage and efficient content delivery. Set up the necessary permissions and links to ensure seamless file access upon purchase. Test the payment and delivery flow thoroughly to ensure a smooth customer experience.
COREMERCH's stacks are designed for creators who want full ownership and control over their digital commerce infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is ready, it's time to go live. Deploy your chosen stack on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, depending on your selection. This process involves setting up the necessary code and configurations for your specific use case. Test the entire flow, from product selection to payment and delivery. Make any necessary adjustments to ensure a seamless user experience. Promote your store through your preferred channels, whether it's social media, email, or your personal website. Engage with your audience, build trust, and drive traffic to your new digital storefront.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling and optimizing. Monitor the performance of your infrastructure and make adjustments as needed. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script allow for backend customization to improve efficiency and handle increased traffic. Consider adding more products to your catalog to attract a wider audience. Expand your marketing efforts to reach new customers and build brand awareness. Continuously gather feedback from your users and iterate on your store's design and functionality. Stay updated with the latest advancements in web3 and decentralized infrastructure to ensure your store remains cutting-edge and competitive.

The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive solution for creators seeking sovereignty and control over their digital commerce. It provides a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. The stack includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. With a one-time fee of $197, you get a complete, deployed Stack 02 in 48 hours, along with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30 days of support. This stack ensures you have the infrastructure to sell your digital products with autonomy and security, free from the restrictions of conventional payment platforms.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can cater to a global audience with diverse payment preferences.

For creators in Zimbabwe and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a robust alternative. This stack, priced at $197, provides a fully functional online store with crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. It leverages the power of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create a decentralized, sovereign commerce infrastructure. With this stack, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, enjoy low transaction fees, and avoid the complexities of KYC and buyer accounts. It's a powerful solution for creators seeking financial autonomy and control over their digital commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your preferred stack: Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) or Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments).
2. Set up your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments.
3. Integrate your crypto wallet to receive funds.
4. Configure file storage and delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
5. Deploy your chosen stack on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages.
6. Test the entire flow, including product selection, payment, and delivery.
7. Promote your store through various channels to attract customers.
8. Continuously monitor and optimize your infrastructure for performance and scalability.
9. Expand your product catalog and marketing efforts to reach a wider audience.
10. Stay updated with web3 advancements to maintain a competitive edge.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments to accept crypto payments?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their website. Choose the cryptocurrencies you want to accept, and configure your payment settings. You'll need to provide your crypto wallet address to receive funds. NOWPayments offers a user-friendly interface to manage your payment settings and track transactions.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare Workers for backend logic?

Cloudflare Workers is a powerful platform for executing backend logic without the need for traditional servers. It allows you to write JavaScript code that runs across Cloudflare's global network, providing low latency and high scalability. Workers enable you to handle complex tasks, customize your store's functionality, and ensure a fast, reliable user experience.
How do I deploy my store on Cloudflare Pages?

To deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to connect your GitHub repository to Cloudflare. Set up the necessary build and deployment settings in your Cloudflare dashboard. Cloudflare Pages will automatically build and deploy your store whenever you push changes to your repository. It's a seamless process that ensures your store is always up-to-date.
What is SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and why is it important?

SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are email authentication protocols that help prevent email spoofing and phishing attacks. By configuring these settings, you ensure that emails sent from your domain are trusted and less likely to be marked as spam. This is crucial for maintaining the reputation of your store and building trust with your customers.
How do I promote my digital store effectively?

Promoting your digital store involves creating a marketing strategy that aligns with your target audience. Utilize social media platforms, email campaigns, and content marketing to reach potential customers. Engage with your audience, showcase the value of your products, and build trust. Consider offering discounts or free samples to early adopters. Continuously analyze your marketing efforts and adjust your strategy based on customer feedback and data-driven insights.
With COREMERCH, you're not just renting infrastructure; you're owning it, ensuring long-term autonomy and resilience.
